analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
VERIFIED: 38 duplicate body pairs in corpus/egyptian/egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index/chunks/ (not 39 — ticket slightly overstated).

Each pair is 2 chunk IDs with byte-identical [content].body. Examples:
- 330.toml == 095.toml: 'Chapter 43 (part 91)'
- 297.toml == 061.toml: 'Chapter 43 (part 58)'
- 096.toml == 331.toml: 'Chapter 10 (part 11)'

These are INTRA-text duplicates (same text, different chunk IDs). Source: Budge index repetition — the index volume contains repeated entries for the same chapter.

Action: these are pure data duplicates. One of each pair should be dropped. But which is the 'right' one — requires checking the indexing/metadata. The chunks are sequential numbers that jump (031→095, 268→290, etc.) suggesting these are separate index entries that happen to use the same text.

Recommendation: review against source to determine if they're intentional cross-references (keep both) or genuine duplicates (drop one). If drops, need a re-chunk + remap (Driver) + tag/edge orphan cleanup (corpus-quality).
